metadata.description: Use the RocketSim CLI (rocketsim on PATH) to inspect and interact with iOS Simulator apps via the rs/1 JSON protocol. Read visible accessibility elements as a compact agent snapshot, then tap, long-press, type, swipe, scroll, focus, or press hardware buttons by stable element id with race protection via screen hashes.
